# duration

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/duration
```

Type-safe, immutable, non-negative duration value object. One class:
`Rasuvaeff\Duration\Duration`. Stored internally as microseconds.

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`.
- Immutable `final readonly class`; private constructor — build via static factories only.
- Non-negative: a negative duration throws `InvalidArgumentException` ("Duration cannot be negative").
- `seconds()` / `minutes()` accept `int|float`; a non-finite float (`INF`/`NAN`) throws `InvalidArgumentException` ("Duration must be finite").
- `toMillis()` rounds **up** (`ceil`): a non-zero sub-millisecond duration never becomes `0` (`0ms` = "no timeout" to most clients). `toMicros()` is exact (storage unit); `toSeconds()` returns `float`.
- `minus()` is **saturating**: subtracting a longer duration yields `0`, never negative. Comparisons go through `compareTo()`.
- `min()` / `max()` are binary static factories (smaller / larger of two).
- `__toString()` (Stringable) yields a human-readable form, choosing the largest unit with value >= 1: `"0"`, `"1µs"`, `"250ms"`, `"2.5s"`, `"1.5min"`, `"2h"`, `"1.5d"`. Milliseconds match `toMillis()` (rounded up); larger units use `%g` (trailing zeros trimmed). The format is an observable contract — changing it is a major bump.

## API

```php
use Rasuvaeff\Duration\Duration;

// Factories
Duration::zero();              // 0
Duration::micros(1_500);       // 1500µs
Duration::millis(250);         // 250ms
Duration::seconds(2.5);        // 2.5s  (int|float)
Duration::minutes(1.5);        // 90s   (int|float)
Duration::hours(1.5);          // 90min (int|float)
Duration::days(0.5);           // 12h   (int|float)

// Conversions
$d = Duration::seconds(2.5);
$d->toMicros();  // 2_500_000 (int, exact)
$d->toMillis();  // 2500       (int, ceil)
$d->toSeconds(); // 2.5        (float)
$d->toMinutes(); // 0.041666…  (float)

// Arithmetic
Duration::millis(500)->plus(Duration::seconds(1));  // 1500ms
Duration::seconds(5)->minus(Duration::seconds(2));  // 3s
Duration::seconds(2)->minus(Duration::seconds(5));  // 0 (saturates)
Duration::min(Duration::seconds(1), Duration::seconds(2));  // 1s
Duration::max(Duration::seconds(1), Duration::seconds(2));  // 2s

// Comparison
$d->isZero();                              // bool
$d->isPositive();                          // bool
$d->equals(Duration::millis(2500));        // bool
$d->compareTo(Duration::seconds(3));       // int -1|0|1
$d->isGreaterThan(Duration::seconds(1));   // bool
$d->isLessThan(Duration::seconds(3));      // bool

// String (Stringable)
(string) Duration::seconds(2.5);   // "2.5s"
(string) Duration::micros(500);    // "500µs"
(string) Duration::zero();         // "0"
```
